events.title: U.S. Dollar Ends Roughly Flat Amid Rising Expectations On Fed Tightening
events.description: The U.S. Dollar value ended almost flat on Friday after several U.S. Federal Reserve officials concurred on the need to raise the interest rates in the December meeting while the U.S.-Iran stalemate continues with no resolution in sight.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends Weak For 4th Straight Session
events.description: The Switzerland market ended weak on Friday, extending recent losses, as rising uncertainty about AI trade and rising cost of debts, as well as fears of possible interest rate hikes by central banks rendered the mood bearish.

events.title: European Markets Close Notably Lower As AI Trade Concerns Trigger Sell-off
events.description: European stocks fell on Friday and several markets across the region hit multi-week lows - some markets even dropped to multi-month lows - weighed down by losses in several sectors, especially in the technology space amid uncertainty about the sustainability of AI trade despite Anthropic's historic IPO.

events.title: TSX Sinks To 6-Month Low As Tech Sector Crumbles
events.description: Canadian equities tumbled Friday as technology stocks plunged 4.4% following global AI trade concerns. The benchmark index dropped 418.25 points to 33,610.48. Materials and financial sectors also declined significantly on weak commodity prices.

events.title: U.S. Consumer Sentiment Improves More Than Previously Estimated November
events.description: A report released by the University of Michigan on Friday showed consumer sentiment in the U.S. improved by more than previously estimated in the month of November. The University of Michigan said its consumer sentiment index for November was upwardly revised to 51.5 from a preliminary reading of 51.0.

events.title: Canadian Market Poised For Negative Open As Oil, Metals Slide
events.description: The Canadian market faces a negative opening Friday as oil prices fall 2% and gold drops 3.13%, while Anthropic's 10% pre-market decline signals weakness in tech stocks amid AI sustainability concerns.

events.title: Euro Falls Amid Risk-Off Mood
events.description: The euro weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Friday, as European stocks traded lower due to ongoing sell-off in artificial intelligence and chip stocks.

events.title: Euro Falls Against Majors
events.description: The euro weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Friday.

events.title: UK Stocks Drift Lower Despite Strong Retail Sales Data
events.description: The FTSE 100 fell 0.61% to 10,389.15 on Friday, pressured by declines in mining, defense, and financial stocks. UK retail sales rebounded 0.7% in October, and consumer confidence improved as borrowing remained below forecasts.

events.title: French Stocks Extend Losing Streak On AI Jitters
events.description: The French benchmark CAC 40 declined 91.70 points to 7,989.04 on Friday, extending losses to a fifth consecutive session. AI valuation concerns weighed on sentiment despite Anthropic's strong stock listing on Wall Street Thursday. Manufacturing and business climate indicators also deteriorated.

events.title: DAX Tumbles 1.64% Amid AI Concerns; Producer Prices Hit 3-Year Peak
events.description: Germany's DAX benchmark declined 1.64% to 25,081.17, extending losses to a sixth consecutive session. Tech stocks led declines amid AI sustainability concerns, while producer price data showed prices climbing 8.1% year-on-year in October, the strongest pace in over three years.

events.title: Indian Shares Surge Despite Global Rout
events.description: Indian shares surged on Friday to hit a 10-month high, with banking, auto and information technology stocks powering the rally.

events.title: Gold Set For Steep Weekly Loss On Rate Hike Worries
events.description: Gold prices were sharply lower on Friday and headed for their biggest weekly decline since March as hawkish Fed remarks signaled more interest-rate hikes in the coming months.
